submission.justification: Crystal-K2 is excluded by the hard background constraint: the Q1 2026 HPGe assay gives 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day intrinsic background (100-3000 keV), about four times the 0.5 budget. Crystal-K1 (0.10 ± 0.03) and Crystal-K3 (0.30 ± 0.05) both pass. K3 gives much better resolution than K1 at every thickness simulated (best 4.48% vs 8.36% FWHM at 662 keV). Scanning K3 from 2 to 8 cm gave 4.97, 4.74, 4.48, 4.63, 4.57 and 5.17% at 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 cm. The minimum is at about 4 cm, and the 4-6 cm range is within simulation noise of the best value. K3 at 4 cm is the recommendation. Caveat: K3's background (0.30 ± 0.05) leaves about 40% margin to the budget, and the resolution values are single 100k-event runs.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
Intrinsic background (100-3000 keV) must not exceed 0.5 counts/kg/day (hard)
requirements.evidence: Q1 2026 assay: K3 = 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day. K2 (2.0) and K1 (0.10) are assessed separately; K2 fails.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K3 at 4 cm gives 4.48% FWHM, the best of the scanned K3 thicknesses (2-8 cm) and better than K1's best of 8.36% at 5 cm. K2 has a better 2025 nominal value (2.9%), but it fails the background constraint and was not chosen.
